title: Women's College Basketball
description:
USC vs. South Carolina
The No. 1 South Carolina Gamecocks face the No. 3 USC Trojans at Bon Secours Wellness Arena in Greenville. USC enters with a three-game win streak and aims for a fourth win, while South Carolina relies on Joyce Edwards to secure a win.

title: NWSL Soccer
description:
Kansas City Current at Gotham FC
Gotham FC host Kansas City Current in the NWSL Championship semifinal at Icahn Stadium. Two of the league's top teams meet in a single-leg tie, with Gotham on three straight wins and Kansas City edging Angel City in extra time to get here.
